name: Velzatinib
sort_evidence: Velzatinib (IDRX-42, GSK6042981) is an unapproved KIT inhibitor in phase 3 against imatinib in first-line GIST (NCT07585266, recruiting), and the book holds no row for it (https://adisinsight.springer.com/drugs/800069789).
